topic: Data structure for demographic and device data
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on structuring the storage of demographic and device data. It was decided that for a given facility (e.g., 200 boxes in Denmark), the system should store pairs linking `facility_id` to a unique set of `device_id`s from other residential facilities.

Regarding demographics, it was proposed that instead of calculating demographic variables based on all devices every time, pre-calculated numbers for each variable and demographic parameter should be stored directly. A separate discussion point addressed the storage method for reference data/dictionaries.
decisions: For a facility, store pairs linking `facility_id` to unique device IDs from other residential facilities.
Pre-calculate and store demographic variables instead of calculating them on demand.
